entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from the network to the UE.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the extended protocol configuration options IE in messages when it needs to transmit protocol data to the UE.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: The user equipment that receives protocol data transmitted via the extended protocol configuration options IE.

entities.name: Protocol data transmission
entities.description: Condition where the network needs to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

relations.description: Network includes the extended protocol configuration options IE in messages when it needs to transmit protocol data to the UE.
The extended protocol configuration options IE is included when the network needs to transmit protocol data to the UE.
The extended protocol configuration options IE enables transmission of protocol data from the network to the UE.
